Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data hallucination and logical error in its final analysis step. It incorrectly swapped the birth dates of the two directors. The WebSurfer correctly identified that Jason Michael Brescia was born on June 19, 1986, and Oscar Barney Finn was born on October 28, 1938. However, in Step 10, the Planner stated: "Oscar Barney Finn born 1986-06-19" and "Jason Michael Brescia born 1943-06-09". This is a complete inversion of the facts gathered in previous steps (Finn is the older director born in 1938, Brescia is the younger born in 1986). Consequently, the Planner concluded that Brescia was born earlier, leading to the wrong answer ("The Newest Pledge"), whereas the correct answer is "M s All De La Aventura" (directed by the older director, Finn).
